title: embedder-openai: an over-limit input is refused, not truncated (known-model input limits, one shared token estimate)
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #37000 (phase 2 row 6, its embedder half); maintainer 2026-11-24 「用fable评审，并分拆第二阶段的任务」. Reviewed by an independent Fable pass before filing.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (topic) · reach: apps that mount `service-knowledge` with `embedder-openai` · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：文本超过嵌入模型的输入上限时，服务商会悄悄截断，后半段内容搜不到，也没有任何报错。
- 修法：已知模型表补上每个模型的输入上限；超限时报错并写明模型名和估算长度，不再截断。表里没有的模型不设上限，只警告一次。另外给出一个平台和应用共用的 token 估算公式。
- 需要你做的：无。不改契约，不用等 ADR，可以现在派。

## What
1. `packages/plugins/embedder-openai/src/index.ts`: add `maxInputTokens` to the known-model table (each value checked against the provider's published docs and cited in the PR); `OpenAIEmbedderOptions.maxInputTokens?` overrides it.
2. `embed()`: an input whose estimate exceeds the limit throws an error naming the model, the estimate and the limit; nothing is truncated. A model not in the table and with no option: no limit, one warning per embedder instance.
3. One shared estimate function, exported from a place both `embedder-openai` and `service-knowledge` already depend on (`@objectstack/spec` shared utilities; name the module in the PR). Formula: CJK characters and full-width punctuation 1.5 each; an ASCII alphanumeric run 1; other punctuation 1; × 1.1. Documented on its docblock and in `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`.
4. `IEmbedder` is not changed (same approach as #36995).

## Acceptance
- Over-limit input → error with model, estimate, limit; under-limit input unchanged.
- Unknown model → no error, one warning.
- A sampled test: the estimate is never below OpenAI `cl100k` token counts on Chinese regulation-like text and mixed Chinese/English text (other tokenizers by documented factor only; they cannot run in CI).
- Container run per AGENTS.md.

## Out of scope
- `IEmbedder.maxInputTokens?` and the service learning the limit (#37098); `IEmbedder.model?` (#37100).
- Splitting text to fit the limit (#37098).

Blocked-by: none.
Parent: #37000. Reader: `domain:server` lane (`packages/plugins/embedder-openai`).
